title: Schemin Week10 — Sports Desk / Reserve / Week11 research pass
scope: Read-only current NFL news and Schemin ownership assessment. No lineup changes, transactions, external writes, or artwork.
method: All224 current roster entries inspected for ownership, current slot and injury flags.
Primary NFL/team reports prioritized; Reuters/AP and clearly attributed reporting used where primary diagnosis was not yet available.
Provider Active/Questionable/Out/IR is a flag, not a new injury diagnosis, official future game status, or an absence duration.
Week11 bye exposure counts existing Week10 starters, not a forecast Week11 lineup.
Publication dates and injury dates are separated; undated/dynamic source timestamps are not invented.
No2025 report has been substituted for current2026 injury news.
Parent production routing: new P34 injury-consequence page under production section S16; P18 performance Sports Desk remains; P25 Reserve Watch carries bye-slot exposure.
finding: The evidence supports serious injuries of different severities and dates, not a blanket claim that many owned players suffered confirmed season-ending injuries on Nov15. Maye is potentially season-ending; Bowers is reportedly day-to-day; Hutchinson is a reported confirmed season-long NFL loss with indirect HMB D/ST ownership. LLC's confirmed Michael Wilson loss dates to Nov8.
